name: great_sling_fs1
title: The frogs' great sling, concept round FS1 (D-129): a bullfrog leaper, a stilt sling, a crayfish winder
_doc: Dominic on GS2's frogs: 'the tortoise one is wrong, and the plain one probably too boring'. Three swamp ideas that repeat none of their beasts (turtle ram, snail catapult, toad bolt thrower, heron war beast, newt cavalry). Size references: a frog worker, the frogs' snail catapult (their great sling's stand-in in play), the humans' great sling as played (GS2). Models: scenes/art_pixel/m13_concepts.gd (FS1), staged from data/later/m13_concepts.json. Notes: docs/concepts/great_sling/README.md.
